svg.title: J5 Remind all overdue: one WhatsApp chat at a time, longest overdue first

g.text: J5 Remind all overdue: one WhatsApp chat at a time, longest overdue first
only customers with a balance above zero
days = todayIso() minus the last payment date,
or minus the first credit date when never paid
sorted by days, most first; ties by larger balance
the app never sends by itself
